part.squareOfPawn.title: The square of the pawn
part.squareOfPawn.summary: Count the square of the pawn to see whether the king catches a running pawn; with the pawn's own king nearby, the count changes.
ex.sq.BOdEl: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.sq.BOdEl.hint: Count the square of your pawn on e3 and see where the white king is.
ex.sq.BOdEl.solution: 65...e2! runs: the square runs from e2 to d1, and the white king on h7 is far away. After 66.g6, 66...e1=Q promotes.
ex.sq.fIFe6: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.sq.fIFe6.hint: Count the square of the pawn on a5 with the pawn to move.
ex.sq.fIFe6.solution: 65.a6! runs: the square runs from a6 to c8, and the black king on e7 is outside it. After 65...Kd6, 66.a7 and the pawn promotes.
ex.sq.a98Qa: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.sq.a98Qa.hint: The white king on b2 is far from your pawn on f4.
ex.sq.a98Qa.solution: 51...f3! runs: the square runs from f3 to d1, and the white king on b2 is outside it. After 52.Kc3, 52...f2 and the pawn promotes.
ex.sq.nFVbI: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.sq.nFVbI.hint: Count the square of the pawn on a5 before dealing with the black pawns.
ex.sq.nFVbI.solution: 57.a6! runs: the square runs from a6 to c8, and the black king on e7 is outside it. After 57...h4, 58.a7 and the pawn promotes.
ex.sq.n4N4t: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.sq.n4N4t.hint: Count both squares: that of the pawn on h6 and that of the black pawn on a3.
ex.sq.n4N4t.solution: 53.h7! runs: the black king on f5 is outside the square. After 53...a2, 54.Kb2 catches the pawn on a2, and the pawn on h7 promotes.
ex.sq.95tj6: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.sq.95tj6.hint: The white king on e1 is inside the square of the pawn on d3. Use your king.
ex.sq.95tj6.solution: 54...Kc2! supports the pawn: the king controls d1 and d2. After 55.Kf2, 55...d2 and the pawn promotes on d1.
ex.sq.MiCJM: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.sq.MiCJM.hint: Count the square of your pawn on g4 with the pawn to move.
ex.sq.MiCJM.solution: 54...g3! runs: the square runs from g3 to e1, and the white king on c5 is outside it. After 55.b6, 55...g2 and the pawn promotes on g1.
part.rookPawnWrongBishop.title: The rook pawn
part.rookPawnWrongBishop.summary: With a rook pawn, the king that reaches the corner usually draws, also against the wrong bishop; the attacker wins by shutting the corner first.
ex.rp.ts3Hg: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.rp.ts3Hg.hint: The black king on e5 is far from the a8 corner.
ex.rp.ts3Hg.solution: 59.Kxa5! captures the pawn. After 59...Kd6, 60.Kb6, and the white king stands in front of the pawn on a3: the black king cannot reach the corner.
ex.rp.SAerO: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.rp.SAerO.hint: The white king on c5 is far from the pawn on h4.
ex.rp.SAerO.solution: 59...Kg4! attacks the pawn on h4. After 60.h5, 60...Kxh5, and the black king stands in front of the pawn on h7.
ex.rp.wb17.hint: Look at the colour of a8 and the colour of the white bishop.
ex.rp.wb17.solution: 1...Kc7 (1...Kc8 also draws) heads for the corner. After 2.Kc5, 2...Kb7, and the king reaches a8: the dark-squared bishop cannot drive it out.
ex.rp.wb18.hint: The black king wants to reach a8 through d7, c7 and b8.
ex.rp.wb18.solution: 1.Kd5 heads for c6, beside the black king's path. After 1...Kd7, 2.Bf4! takes c7 and b8 away from the black king, and it cannot reach a8 (1.Bf4 Kd7 2.Kd5 reaches the same position).
ex.rp.Ezeci: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.rp.Ezeci.hint: Your king on g1 holds the pawn on h3. Count the square of the pawn on a2.
ex.rp.Ezeci.solution: 58.a4! runs: the black king on g3 is outside the square of the pawn, and the white king on g1 holds the pawn on h3 near the corner. After 58...Kf4, 59.a5.
ex.rp.wGKEV: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.rp.wGKEV.hint: Look at the colour of g1 and the colour of the white bishop.
ex.rp.wGKEV.solution: 42...Kxh2! captures the last white pawn. After 43.Kf5, 43...g3, and the g-pawn promotes on g1, a dark square, out of reach of the light-squared bishop.
